indicator_name: Second-tier banks' borrowings from the government, local executive bodies and the national managing holding (account group 2030), from international financial organisations (2040) and from other banks (2050)
description: Займы, полученные банками второго уровня от Правительства РК, МИО и национального управляющего холдинга (группа счетов 2030), от МФО (2040) и от других банков (2050)
unit: million KZT, as at the date
methodology: NBK «Сведения по остаткам на балансовых и внебалансовых счетах» (banks-performance rubric, one workbook per year, one sheet per 01.MM), total row of all second-tier banks, thousand KZT / 1000; 01.01 from the sheet after final turnovers («с ЗО»). Items G2030, G2040, G2050. G2030 (bn): 47.5 at 2010-01-01, 58.4 (2011-01-01), 329.4 (2013-01-01), 399.8 (2015-01-01), 162.0 (2016-01-01), 69.8 (2021-12-01), 85.5 (2023-01-01), 211.9 (2023-02-01), 683.7 (2026-01-01), 712.0 (2026-08-01). BREAK 2023-02-01: group 2030 adds «специального фонда развития частного предпринимательства» (Damu): +126 bn in 2030, -167 bn in 2050 that month; G2030 + G2050 is continuous across it. G2050 also holds interbank borrowing (1.4-1.75 trn in 2022-04..09). Checked on every sheet: total = sum of bank rows; group names match the known wordings (a new wording stops the dataset). Past years are carried forward; the current and previous year's workbooks are re-read on each weekly refresh.
